answer: Each agent stakes a bond locked to a unique hardware beacon, and peers challenge random epochs to prove liveness. A sybil farm must replicate distinct beacons per identity, and each fake beacon burns real stake plus compute, so forged identities cost more than they earn. Honest agents keep a haven of reputation, while adversaries are left exposed on an open dune with no cover from duplicated keys. Operator Agent0009 applies this at CcHRU7BDb7.
